purpose: Attempt-volume/model-adequacy investigation, not a new scientific exposure test
center_population: All 4117 primary accounting rows including zero FTA; outcomes not used

D0.definition: Exact failed Stage 3C; reuse saved diagnostics/PPC without refitting

D1.definition: Stage 3C accuracy mean plus gamma_FTA * centered_log1p_FTA

D2.definition: Unchanged Stage 3C accuracy mean; log(kappa_it)=gamma_0 + gamma_k * centered_log1p_FTA

D3.definition: Joint NegativeBinomial FTA with fixed log(GP) offset and BetaBinomial FTM|FTA; correlated non-centered player opportunity/accuracy intercepts

prior_predictive.accuracy_gate: Same gross screen as Stage 3C: all mu finite; at most 25% below .01 and at most 25% above .99
prior_predictive.rationale: 100 expected FTA per player per game is an intentionally very generous gross-scale bound, not an empirical NBA record or a fit target. More than 1% prior mass above that sustained rate, or more than 0.1% simulated seasons above one million attempts, is grossly implausible. Neither bound is derived from the observed accuracy association.
prior_predictive.failure_action: STOP before any outcome posterior fitting. Retain the suggested priors and record the failure; no automatic prior amendment in this run.

diagnostics.sealed_parameter_handling: Include anonymous convergence diagnostics for the sealed slope; never export its location, scale, interval, sign or posterior probability; no raw trace plot of that parameter

PPC.pattern_definition: For each bin, bias=replicate mean minus observed. Evidence of direction requires abs(bias)>2.576*MCSE(replica mean), MCSE estimated by 40 consecutive batch means of 50 replicates in chain-major draw order. Both low bins same sign and both high bins opposite sign triggers failure. This is Monte Carlo uncertainty, not posterior predictive interval width.

joint_failure_rules.season_total_gross_rule: At least ceil(n_seasons/3) season totals outside 99% predictive intervals in the same direction

PPC.conditional_accuracy: Hold observed FTA fixed, using joint posterior
PPC.joint_generation: Simulate all FTA then FTM conditional on simulated FTA and the same correlated player draw
PPC.baseline_policy: Reuse original 1000 saved D0 replications; no re-evaluation to seek a different baseline outcome

selection.inputs: Typed gate booleans/counts only; no parameter summaries or traces

minute_limitation: Public NBA game-level minute displays and the archived game records agreed at the available whole-second resolution in the audited sample, while small discrepancies remained between summed game displays and NBA season-level decimal minute displays. Because season-level MIN was not the scientific outcome, exposure, or primary model predictor, and because shooting counts and analytical eligibility reconciled, the amended prospective validation protocol treated season-total MIN as an ancillary representation field rather than an exact numerical release gate. The internal NBA aggregation mechanism remains unknown.
